import sys
import heapq

def main():
    import sys
    import heapq
    
    def readints():
        return list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    
    data = readints()
    n = data[0]
    a = data[1:]
    
    # Create a min-heap with the desired ratings
    heapq.heapify(a)
    
    # Initialize the result array
    b = [0] * n
    
    # Assign the smallest available rating to each user
    current_rating = 0
    for i in range(n):
        # Get the smallest desired rating
        smallest_desired = heapq.heappop(a)
        # Assign the next available rating that is at least the desired rating
        current_rating = max(current_rating + 1, smallest_desired)
        b[i] = current_rating
    
    # Print the result
    print(" ".join(map(str, b)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
